_comment: UC1 Supply Chain Security Pipeline — Policy Configuration
_doc: Place this file in the pipeline output directory. The pipeline loads it automatically if present.

_fields.max_critical_cves: Block pipeline if this many Critical CVEs found (0 = any Critical blocks)
_fields.max_high_cves: Block pipeline if more than this many High CVEs found
_fields.blocked_licenses: SPDX license identifiers — any match blocks the pipeline
_fields.allow_untrusted_sources: If false, deps from non-standard Maven repos trigger a violation
_fields.fail_on_secrets: If true, any detected secret at or above secret_severity_threshold blocks the pipeline
_fields.allow_snapshot_versions: If false, -SNAPSHOT versions in production scope trigger a violation
_fields.trusted_group_prefixes: Group ID prefixes considered trusted sources (overrides untrusted_source check)
_fields.max_composite_risk_score: Block any dep with a composite risk score above this threshold
_fields.require_jacoco_coverage_pct: JaCoCo gate threshold (%) — gate fails if coverage is below this
_fields.auto_merge_bump_types: Bump types eligible for auto-merge after all gates pass
_fields.block_major_auto_merge: If true, MAJOR bumps always require human approval regardless of gate results
_fields.secret_severity_threshold: Minimum secret severity to trigger fail_on_secrets (CRITICAL / HIGH / MEDIUM / LOW)
